purpose: Prospectively test a frozen direct-demand specialist router on one common EIA-930 hour across eight balancing authorities, with every prediction sealed before the common target interval begins.

predecessor.reason_for_successor: SWPP and TVA target-hour EIA demand forecasts arrive after the target interval begins under observed source timing. Version 2 removes target-hour official forecast dependence without weakening the pre-interval seal or backfilling version 1.

design_boundary: Candidate definitions, features, hyperparameters, training windows, route selection, sample gates, and release gates are frozen before prospective collection. Version 1 outcomes may not select or alter version 2 routes.

source.product: Form EIA-930 hourly demand by balancing authority
source.credential_policy: Read EIA_API_KEY or EIA_API_KEY_PREMIUM from the process environment and never serialize the credential.

historical_design.selection_rule: For each authority, select the lexicographically tie-broken candidate with the lowest mean scaled absolute error on the frozen validation window.
historical_design.claim_rule: Historical design scores select the frozen route map and are exploratory, not prospective confirmation evidence.

feature_contract.level_scale_definition: Median positive actual demand across offsets 24 through 191 before the target.
feature_contract.error_scale_definition: Median positive absolute one-hour demand difference across offsets 24 through 191 before the target.

candidates.definition: Actual demand for the same authority 24 hours before the target.
Actual demand for the same authority 168 hours before the target.
Equal-weight mean of the 24-hour and 168-hour seasonal-naive forecasts.
Deterministic ridge forecast of target demand normalized by a lag-only local level scale.
Deterministic XGBoost forecast of target demand normalized by a lag-only local level scale.
Deterministic LightGBM forecast of target demand normalized by a lag-only local level scale.

model_contract.fit_rule: Fit each model only on complete rows in the frozen historical window. Prospective outcomes do not update model weights.

prediction_seal.target_interval: The one-hour UTC interval ending at target_period_end_utc.
prediction_seal.incomplete_panel_rule: Fail closed and seal no panel if any authority lacks a required lag or violates a seal condition.
prediction_seal.late_or_backfilled_target_rule: Skip the target and record the reason. Never create a prediction after the target interval begins.
prediction_seal.settlement_rule: Append one settlement panel only after all eight target actuals are available for an already sealed panel.

claim_boundary: A passing confirmatory result would support bounded prospective public-data evidence for a frozen direct-demand hourly specialist router across the declared eight-authority panel. It does not establish patent validity or scope, utility control, realized savings, grid reliability improvement, production readiness, trading edge, or universal model superiority.
